It builds cleanly, but I haven't run the game to check visually, and the recording wasn't there to compare against: `/app/.harbor_assets/` doesn't exist in the container. Everything below comes from reading the code and checking it against the camera math.\n\n1. **Sprites shown mirrored, all the time** (`irr/src/CBillboardSceneNode.cpp`). Floating sprites always turn to face the camera. The left and right edges of their image were swapped, so any image that isn't symmetrical appeared mirrored from every angle. I swapped the image coordinates back.\n\n2. **Flat two-sided elements mirrored from behind** (`src/client/content_cao.cpp`, back face of `upright_sprite`). The back face reused the front face's corner layout with the drawing order reversed, so the back image came out mirrored. I rebuilt the back face so the image reads correctly from that side.\n\n3. **Wrong direction picture as you walk around a turned sprite** (`updateTexturePos`). Some sprites have one picture per viewing direction (front, left, back, right). The code added the entity's turn angle to the viewing angle when it should subtract it. Any turned entity, such as a penguin facing its walking direction, therefore showed the wrong picture.\n   - I also made this choice use the camera direction as seen by the entity itself, so a turn inherited from a carrier is included.\n   - When a sprite is put down, any leftover turn from being carried is now cleared.\n\n4. **Carried animated sprites stuck on their first frame** (`GenericCAO::step`). The animation timer only advanced for entities that weren't attached to anything, so an element carried by the penguin never animated. I moved it out of that branch so it runs for every entity.\n\nI had to rely on memory for what the upstream engine code looks like; I had no reference copy to diff against. For fixes 1 and 2, the camera math confirms the old layout was mirrored, so I'm confident in them.\n\nThe best way to confirm is to set up the same yard and watch it from front, side and behind. The devtest test entities (`testentities:yawsprite`, `testentities:upright_sprite`) show these cases."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":216,"cache_read_input_tokens":65907,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":216,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"df468aca-e033-4a66-a53d-6130a000140c","uuid":"9dabdfb9-0687-45a3-bb85-950bb0490c1f","timestamp":"2026-11-16T17:55:55.596Z"}
